Honoring Our Heroes
Join us at Cowabunga Vegas for Heroes Weekend, a four-day celebration honoring those who serve and protect our communities. EMS, medical personnel, police, firefighters, and military receive free admission as our way of saying thank you.
 
Come relax, recharge, and enjoy a weekend of fun with your family. This one's for you!
